== Walkthrough ==

''Feskr Drinkmaster is located at 108, 42, 19 in Kerra Island.''

You say, 'Hail, Feskr Drinkmaker'

: Feskr Drinkmaker says 'Erh? If you not be here to help Feskr with his [problem] then Feskr want you to leave.'

You say, 'What problem?'

: Feskr Drinkmaker says 'You wish to help? Orrderrr of supplies I rrequest not arrive; ship sink. Now Feskr needs supplies. Feskr need bottle of [[Tunare's Finest]], [[Thunderhoof Mushroom|thunderhoof mushroom]], [[Tea Leaves|tea leaf]], and [[Handmade Backpack|handmade backpack]]. Rrrr, strange items but Feskr need to sell. You bring. Feskr give you nice bag.'

''Wela Muselender is located at +95, -345 in Tovania's Venom in Northern Felwithe.''

You say, 'Hail, Wela Muselender'

: Wela Muselender curtseys and says, 'Welcome to our fine tavern! Our relaxing atmosphere and pleasant wines are excellent for assisting an artist or poet in finding their muse.'

'''Purchase a bottle of Tunare's Finest.'''

'''Travel to South Karana and forage a [[Thunderhoof Mushroom]].'''

'''Travel to Eask Karana and forage [[Tea Leaves]].'''

'''Purchase or craft a [[Hand Made Backpack]](combine a High Quality Bear Skin and a Backpack Pattern in a sewing kit or loom, trivial 88).'''

Hand Feskr Drinkmaker the items.

: Feskr Drinkmaker says 'Ahhh. This will help. Many Kerrans will like these. Here. Take this old bag. I have too many. Maybe it help you.'

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Kerra Isle]] got better.
</div>
